recs.stt: 'Oumuamua: An analysis of the debate regarding the first interstellar visitor
recs.x:
I believe in aliens from a statistical standpoint.

But I don't believe in interstellar travel at all. I don't think people grasp the distances between stars. The longest distance a human has traveled through space is to the moon. If, for scale, this was about 2 millimeters, then the nearest star would be another 200 kilometers/124 miles away. Here's a great video to illustrate [link]
